area: 中国 G102 国道（以 OSM 路线几何为准）

sampling.datumHandling: Query points are converted WGS84 -> GCJ-02 because the endpoint interprets its arguments as GCJ-02; returned scenes are converted GCJ-02 -> WGS84 before measuring against the WGS84 OSM route. Skipping either conversion would shift every measurement by 300-600 m in China.

completeness.claimScope: Completeness relative to the supplied OSM G102 way geometry and Tencent endpoint responses at scan time.
completeness.latticeArgument: Every OSM segment is sampled every 100 m along-track at cross-track offsets [0.0]. Any point within 50 m of the route is therefore at most 100 m from a sample point, which is far inside the 3000 m discovery radius, so its nearest panorama is always returned.
completeness.graphArgument: Each accepted nearest hit is expanded through Tencent /sv all_scenes, roads.points and vpoints.link up to 3 hops, with a 50 m route corridor fence.
unresolved: OSM omissions or a Tencent panorama not exposed by /xf, /sv, all_scenes, roads.points or links cannot be ruled out by this dataset.
Samples marked empty, far, or error are retained in the audit and require review if the route geometry is later corrected.
